title: Federal Register: Submission for OMB Review; Certain Federal Acquisition Regulation Part 4 Requirements (OMB Control No. 9000-0189)

history.reason: Source read directly (PDF from GovInfo converted to text) on the access date; findings transcribed from the document.

publisher: DoD, GSA and NASA (via GovInfo / Federal Register)
source_type: Government Paperwork Reduction Act notice (consolidated FAR Part 4 information collection)
reliability: Government document; the issuing agencies (DoD, GSA, NASA) also administer the registration and certification requirements they estimate. Burden figures are agency estimates, not measurements.
findings: The collection covers FAR Part 4 items including TIN information, unique entity identifier, SAM registration and maintenance (FAR 52.204-7, 52.204-13, 52.212-3(b)), service contract reporting in SAM, CAGE code reporting, ownership or control of offeror, predecessor of offeror, and Kaspersky-related reporting.

The notice states FAR 52.204-13 requires contractors to keep SAM data current, accurate and complete through final payment, with maintenance at a minimum done through an annual review and update of the SAM registration.

Annual burden: 353,291 respondents, 843,253 total annual responses, 387,083 total burden hours. Dividing hours by responses gives about 0.46 hours per response (our arithmetic, not stated in the notice).
A 60-day notice published December 20, 2024 (89 FR 104154) drew no comments.
limitations: The burden is a single aggregate across about eight different requirements; it is not broken out for SAM registration, for first-time registrants, or for small businesses.
Agency estimate with no stated method; actual time, third-party fees and registration problems are not measured.
Only the notice itself was read; the supporting statement submitted to OMB was not.
